title: Choose the Atlas composition
question: Which composition should carry forward? Approve one, or use the note to combine, revise or reject them. Chart proportions will be bound exactly to the exported data in implementation.

options.label: 1 · Clinical Editorial
options.thesis: The selected centered introduction leads into headline figures and stacked charts.
options.viewport: A prominent centered title and paired entry actions sit above four statistics, followed by the first reporting chart.
options.risk: The introduction takes more space before the reader reaches the first explanation.

options.label: 2 · Explanation Beside Evidence
options.thesis: The introduction and a reporting figure explain the subject together in the first view.
options.viewport: The title and reading actions occupy the left, the reaction-term chart the right, with cohort context and the next reading region below.
options.risk: The opening reporting chart needs a clear caveat so report counts cannot be read as treatment risk.

options.label: 3 · Guided Chapter Reading
options.thesis: Persistent chapter wayfinding frames a focused lesson about what the reporting data can establish.
options.viewport: A left chapter rail supports a compact title and a prominent indication-completeness lesson, with evidence details beginning below.
options.risk: The rail uses horizontal space; mobile must collapse it into an accessible chapter control. The preview's completeness bar needs the exact 52.2/47.8 ratio in code.
